criterion_text: females complaining of pelvic congestion: dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, chronic pelvic pain, menorrhagia, metrorrhagia
question: For this registered inclusion criterion, must the patient report any one, all five, or a different combination of the five symptoms? Can the current presenting complaint and a source description of the participant as a woman or female be used without an additional duration, scale or assessment?
